levels.title: Foundations
levels.description: Getting started with FastAPI — understand why it exists, set up your first app, and learn the basics of routing, path parameters, and query parameters.

topics.title: Why FastAPI
topics.summary: Understand what makes FastAPI different from other Python web frameworks.

topics.title: Installation & First App
topics.summary: Install FastAPI, create a minimal app, run it with uvicorn, and explore auto-generated docs.

topics.title: Path Operations & HTTP Methods
topics.summary: Map HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) to FastAPI route decorators.

topics.title: Path Parameters
topics.summary: Declare path parameters with type validation, enum support, and path converters.

topics.title: Query Parameters
topics.summary: Use query parameters with defaults, validation, aliases, and the modern Annotated style.

levels.title: Data Handling & Validation
levels.description: Master request bodies, Pydantic v2 validation, response models, error handling, headers, cookies, and file uploads.

topics.title: Request Body & Pydantic Models
topics.summary: Define request bodies with Pydantic models, nest models, and combine body with path/query params.

topics.title: Deep Validation with Pydantic v2
topics.summary: Field constraints, validators, special types, model config, and partial updates.

topics.title: Response Models & Status Codes
topics.summary: Filter responses with response_model, set status codes, and return different response types.

topics.title: Errors & Exception Handlers
topics.summary: Raise HTTPException, create custom exception handlers, and structure error responses.

topics.title: Cookies, Headers & Form Data
topics.summary: Read cookies and headers, handle form data submissions, and set response cookies.

topics.title: File Uploads
topics.summary: Handle file uploads with UploadFile, validate content types and sizes, and stream safely.

levels.title: Async & Architecture
levels.description: Understand async vs sync execution, middleware, dependency injection, background tasks, and application lifespan.

topics.title: Async vs Sync — How FastAPI Runs Your Code
topics.summary: Learn when to use async def vs def, and avoid the #1 FastAPI performance bug.

topics.title: Middleware, CORS & Gzip
topics.summary: Write custom middleware, configure CORS, and enable Gzip compression.

topics.title: Dependency Injection System
topics.summary: Master FastAPI's killer feature — dependencies, sub-dependencies, yield teardown, and router-level guards.

topics.title: Background Tasks
topics.summary: Run work after the response is sent, and understand when to use a real task queue instead.

topics.title: Application Lifespan (Startup/Shutdown)
topics.summary: Manage startup and shutdown events with the modern lifespan context manager.

levels.title: Security & Database
levels.description: Implement OAuth2 + JWT authentication and master SQLAlchemy 2.0 with async sessions, relationships, and Alembic migrations.

topics.title: Security: OAuth2 + JWT Authentication
topics.summary: Password hashing, JWT creation/verification, current-user dependencies, scopes, and security hardening.

topics.title: Databases: SQLAlchemy 2.0 + Alembic
topics.summary: Set up async engines, sessions, models, CRUD operations, and Alembic migrations.

topics.title: Database Relationships
topics.summary: One-to-many, many-to-many, eager loading strategies, and solving the N+1 problem.

levels.title: Testing & Production
levels.description: Test with pytest and httpx, structure modular projects, use WebSockets, configure settings, deploy with Docker, and apply production patterns.

topics.title: Testing (pytest + httpx)
topics.summary: TestClient, database-per-test fixtures, dependency overrides, and testing authenticated endpoints.

topics.title: Routers & Modular Project Structure
topics.summary: Organize code with APIRouter, prefixes, tags, and a professional project layout.

topics.title: WebSockets
topics.summary: Real-time communication with WebSocket endpoints, connection managers, and broadcasting.

topics.title: Configuration & Settings
topics.summary: Manage settings with pydantic-settings, .env files, and dependency injection.

topics.title: Docker & Docker Compose Deployment
topics.summary: Write Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, and docker-compose with Postgres and Redis.

topics.title: Production Patterns
topics.summary: Logging, pagination, rate limiting, caching, and handling long-running tasks.

topics.title: Professional Checklist & Resources
topics.summary: A comprehensive pre-shipping checklist and resources for continued learning.
